Explanation: The Authenticated Item is the Core Value Unit: a luxury handbag, accessory, watch or jewelry item that Rebag has accepted, vetted and made available for resale.

Rebag is the central buyer, curator, authenticator and reseller in the transaction. Unlike a classic peer-to-peer marketplace, it often takes the item into its own controlled inventory flow before selling it onward.
Rebag turns heterogeneous luxury supply into a standardized, trusted resale assortment.
By controlling pricing, authentication and the customer experience, Rebag can earn resale margin and build a premium trust brand.
Taking control of goods creates inventory, authentication, pricing, return and working-capital risk that a lighter marketplace can push to participants.
Rebag buys, consigns or accepts luxury items from Sellers and then resells authenticated inventory to Buyers.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Payment — Luxury Buyers pay Rebag for authenticated inventory. | → Consumer · Authenticated Item — Rebag provides the vetted luxury item to the Buyer. | ← Provider · Luxury Item — Luxury Sellers send or bring items to Rebag for buyout, consignment or trade. | → Provider · Quote / Payout — Rebag provides a quote and pays or credits the Seller according to the selected resale route. | ← Partner · Services — Commerce partners provide payment, logistics, financing or retail support. | → Partner · Fees / Volume — Rebag creates transaction and service volume for supporting partners.
